items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I did some stuff with Kathy Chamberlain.

ctx.x: We were talking around '57, '58, the time of, oh, say, the Sputnik, the boycotts in the South, the television shows like Walt Disney, Peter Gunn -- that period in the Popular Culture.
I don't know what the year... I did some stuff with Kathy Chamberlain.
That early? Years ago? Like 1960? She was much too young. She's younger than I am.
